classification.confidence: high for the evidence ceiling, low for actual guest progress
classification.basis: The ordinary unelevated harness captured no guest console, kernel ring, ETW, crash dump, or command marker. The host reported a closed connection during CreateVm. Under the checkpoint contract, unobserved guest entry supports only B0 even though the parent configuration previously proved B3.

ordinaryEvidence.hostFailure: Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/CreateVm/0x80072746: existing connection forcibly closed by remote host
networkingWarnings: Mirrored networking was reported unsupported and fell back to NAT.
NAT configuration failed with VM_E_INVALID_STATE and fell back to networkingMode None.

interpretation: The networking messages do not establish the terminal guest failure. The same minimal lineage intentionally omits Hyper-V networking, and the host reported fallback to no networking.
This trial neither proves nor disproves that CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS removes the K-STORAGE-001 crash.
Parent-trial B3 evidence cannot be promoted to evidence that this particular boot reached B3.
decision: Preserve this ordinary trial as inconclusive at B0. Do not add networking, cgroups, seccomp, page reporting, or console features from these host messages. A byte-identical K-OVERLAY diagnostic rerun with WPR/ETW is justified because ordinary evidence cannot classify the post-overlay boundary; it requires separate explicit approval and elevation.
